<h2>Save Trait Source Scale Report</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Writes a durable Markdown audit and source-domain-taxon count table for
interim VegVault source scaling, including the provisional TRY LMA warning.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>save_trait_source_scale_report(
  data_trait_records_raw,
  data_trait_records_source_scaled,
  data_trait_source_scale_rule_audit,
  data_trait_source_scale_record_audit,
  data_trait_review_application_audit,
  path_vegvault,
  path_report,
  path_taxon_counts
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records_raw">data_trait_records_raw</code></td>
<td>
<p>Untouched extracted trait records.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records_source_scaled">data_trait_records_source_scaled</code></td>
<td>
<p>Records after approved source scaling.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_source_scale_rule_audit">data_trait_source_scale_rule_audit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Rule-level audit from [apply_trait_source_scale_rules()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_source_scale_record_audit">data_trait_source_scale_record_audit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Record-level audit from [apply_trait_source_scale_rules()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_application_audit">data_trait_review_application_audit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Review-layer application audit with 'n_source_satisfied'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_vegvault">path_vegvault</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to the VegVault SQLite database.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_report">path_report</code></td>
<td>
<p>Output path for the Markdown report.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_taxon_counts">path_taxon_counts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Output path for the source-domain-taxon count CSV.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Character vector containing both written paths.
</p>
